3.t: on open pages ˹for all to read˺

4.t: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited

6.t: And by the seas set on fire

7.t: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

9.t: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently

10.t: and the mountains will be blown away entirely

11.t: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

12.t: those who amuse themselves with falsehood

13.t: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell
13.tr: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

14.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny
14.tr: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

15.t: Is this magic, or do you not see
15.tr: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

16.t: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”
16.tr: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

17.t: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss

18.t: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
18.tr: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum Wa-waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

19.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
19.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee-'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

20.t: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

21.t: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed
21.tr: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at-hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum Wa-maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

22.t: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire

23.t: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness
23.tr: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa Wa-laa taaseem

24.t: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls
24.tr: Wa-yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka-annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

25.t: They will turn to one another inquisitively

26.t: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people
26.tr: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

27.t: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat

28.t: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
28.tr: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

29.t: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
29.tr: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw Wa-laa majnoon

30.t: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”
30.tr: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

31.t: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”
31.tr: Qul tarabbasoo fa-innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

32.t: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people
32.tr: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

33.t: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith
33.tr: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

34.t: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true
34.tr: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

35.t: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators
35.tr: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

36.t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺
36.tr: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal-ard; bal laa yooqinoon

37.t: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺
37.tr: Am 'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

38.t: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof
38.tr: Am lahum sullamuien yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

39.t: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons

40.t: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
40.tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

41.t: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

42.t: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes
42.tr: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

43.t: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺
43.tr: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

44.t: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
44.tr: Wa-ien yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitaien yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

45.t: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
45.tr: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

46.t: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped
46.tr: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw Wa-laa hum yunsaroon

47.t: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know
47.tr: Wa-inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika Wa-laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

48.t: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
48.tr: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa-innaka bi-a'yuninaa Wa-sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

49.t: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars
